title: Bounded Configuration Codes
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite binary input, and let $s$ be a natural number. The finite set $R(N,x,s)$ consists of the natural numbers $u$ satisfying $u<2^{K(N)(s+L(|x|)+1)}$ and the predicate $RCode(N,x,s,u)$, where $K$ is the machine code-width function, $L$ is the space-bound function, and $RCode$ is the defining predicate for these codes.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
